title: incident-bot: oncall runbook heuristics & SLO toolkit helpers
author: Aisha Khan
description: Motivation: on-call engineers frequently rely on incident-bot to surface relevant runbooks and SLO hints during high-severity incidents. Current matching is brittle for multi-signal alerts and does not weight SLO context heavily. This PR implements improved heuristics for runbook relevance scoring and exposes a small set of SLO-toolkit helper APIs to provide richer context (remaining error budget, burn rate buckets, recent regression markers). Changes are intentionally backward-compatible: existing runbook links are preserved and the heuristic is enabled behind a feature flag 'runbook_heuristics_v2' which is off by default. Summary of changes: - new runbook scoring module with signal weighting (latency/5xx/errors, SLO proximity, ownership tags) - SLO toolkit helpers: public functions to compute proximity and short-form hints consumed by incident-bot - integration layer in incident-bot that merges heuristic results with current quicklinks ranking - lightweight caching (TTL 2m) and metrics for scoring latency and match-quality - added unit and integration tests for heuristics and API contract - docs: updated oncall quicklinks README and runbook guidance Checklist: - [x] implement scoring algorithm and API surface - [x] add unit tests and integration test harness - [x] add metrics and dashboards (placeholder grafana panel) - [x] add feature flag and rollout plan - [x] update docs and runbook guidance Rollout plan: enable behind feature flag in staging, collect match-quality metric (runbook_click_through / suggested_links) for 72h, small canary on internal teams, then gradual rollout. Related: ENG-2345 (oncall UX improvements), ENG-2401 (SLO hinting).
